purpose: Trial 4의 needs ✅ 강함(4+회 반복) 결과로 Card 컴포넌트 도입. surface/elevated × none/sm/md/lg API + interfaceColors cascade.

steps.name: adr-draft-and-init
steps.summary: phases/12-card/{index.json,step0~5.md} skeleton 생성. docs/ADR.md에 ADR-015 추가 (맥락/결정/대안/결과/관계/후속). .changeset/12-card.md 생성 (@wonik/web minor).

steps.name: types-and-failing-tests
steps.summary: packages/web/src/Card/types.ts 생성 (CardVariant/CardPadding/CardOwnProps/CardProps, Box 패턴 답습 — forwardRef 미사용). Card.test.tsx에 14 케이스 작성.

steps.name: card-implementation
steps.summary: Card.tsx 구현. variant=surface는 1px border+interfaceColors.border, elevated는 light box-shadow + className suffix 'wonik-card-elevated'. dark theme box-shadow 0은 module-scope CSS inject(data-wonik-card)로 분기. padding 매핑(none=0/sm=10px/md=16px/lg=32px). border-radius radius.md=10px.

steps.name: reexport-build-test
steps.summary: Card/index.ts + packages/web/src/index.ts re-export. pnpm build tokens+web 성공 (dist/index.mjs/cjs/d.ts 산출). pnpm test 177 passing (163+14, 회귀 0).

steps.name: sandbox-matrix-capture
steps.summary: apps/web-sandbox/src/App.tsx에 CardMatrixSection 추가 (2 variant × 4 padding = 8 셀). Vite dev 5174 부팅, headless Chrome 캡쳐 3개: phase-12-card-matrix.png(180KB) + phase-12-card-matrix-zoom.png(919KB, 2x scale) + phase-12-card-matrix-dark.png. 8 셀 모두 visible — surface row는 border 보임, elevated row는 약한 그림자 (육안 검증, AI Read tool로 확인).

steps.name: adr-finalize-prd-closure
steps.summary: ADR-015 finalize (Step 0에서 사실상 완성 — Step 5에서 추가 변경 0). docs/PRD.md '1단계 진행 현황' 표에 Phase 11·12 행 추가 + '다음 후보' Trial 5로 갱신. spec §5 S1–S10 자동 검증 모두 ✅. closure 완료.
